intent: Implement EventLogService exactly as tabled. Telemetry Event Log rule owner. append persists the sample through EventLogRepository (append-only; corrections and backfills become new revisions), then counts telemetry.eventlog.appended with tag kind=record or kind=revision, emits the step log (eventlog.record.appended for RECORD, eventlog.revision.appended for REVISION), publishes the EventRecord through EventBroadcast (true: step log eventlog.broadcast.published; false: counter telemetry.pipeline.dropped tag stage=broadcast, the record stays persisted), and writes an audit entry (actor eventlog, action append, outcome success, correlationId of the sample). On repository failure it counts telemetry.pipeline.dropped tag stage=eventlog, audits outcome failure, and completes empty without propagating the error (on_false path: the sample is lost and counted). observability.step_logs: eventlog.record.appended ; observability.step_logs: eventlog.revision.appended ; observability.step_logs: eventlog.broadcast.published (all via the StepLog instance method emit). observability.step_logs = ["eventlog.record.appended", "eventlog.revision.appended", "eventlog.broadcast.published"]

methods.signature: EventLogService(EventLogRepository repository, EventBroadcast broadcast, AuditTrail auditTrail, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)

methods.semantics: repository failure: counted in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=eventlog}, audited as failure, completes empty; broadcast refusal: counted in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=broadcast}
